Findings

    cachereaper

    Free & open source

    What is big, and what is safe

    cachereaper maps a folder and paints the caches and build artifacts it can identify, so you can see what is big and safe to remove.

    • low regenerates itself — package caches, DerivedData
    • medium reinstallable — node_modules, virtualenvs
    • high review each — toolchains, simulator devices
    • unclassified no rule claims it, so it is never offered

    What should I look at?

    Nothing is read until you name a folder.

    Scanning only reads. Nothing is deleted unless you select it and confirm, and the folder you pick is the only place outside your home directory cachereaper is allowed to touch this session.
